title: Smithfield budget board drafts liaison role for each town department

Smithfield budget board drafts liaison role for each town department
The board discussed assigning a BFRB liaison to guide, rather than deeply question, each department ahead of its budget presentation.
The Smithfield Financial Budget and Financial Review Board on Tuesday, Oct. 13, 2026, discussed a draft proposal creating a BFRB liaison assigned to each town department for the fiscal 2028 budget process.
THE LIAISON'S ROLE Under the draft, every department would have an assigned BFRB liaison to guide them through the presentation and discussion process rather than conducting a detailed review of the budget. A board member described the role this way: "They have to have someone to talk someone to answer any general questions they may have."
A board member described the shift from the prior process: "We're actually going to be getting those kind of answers to the questions up front through the statements of change."
COMMUNICATION EXPECTATIONS The draft states departments are strongly encouraged to contact their assigned BFRB liaison prior to submitting materials, and that substantive budget communications should be documented and shared with the liaison. One member argued for formalizing this in writing, saying, "as the independent body we set the um the rules of operation."
The board also discussed consolidating the liaison role with the chair for certain department responses, with one member saying, "that way that way we don't have a lot of that cross mind."
NEXT STEPS The chair noted the document was presented as "consider, discuss, and act," but said a motion to defer was appropriate to allow further consideration and modifications. No vote was recorded on the liaison section during the discussion.
